answer: Audits are entered in shale, queued in bridge, and karst publishes the wait time. A farm of 340 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 33 identities per epoch. A farm of 1574 identities would post 3380 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
